slice_title: S12 — Claim-backed native supervisor review closure
slice_goal: Implement claim-backed findings and native supervisor review closure for one App Server campaign while retaining canonical ownership of claim mechanics, reviewer execution, implementation-review admission, review-episode lineage, campaign decisions, checkpoint/profile creation, and terminal receipts.
outcome: Accepted candidate 3 established plural supervisor-selected native review obligations, retained review/remediation recovery, exact claim-backed finding revisions and builder reliance, and fail-closed terminalization without making claims or reviewers acceptance authorities. Two bounded remediation iterations resolved five generic findings and AIR-S12-1. The accepted tree was publicly committed as 502a336d with the exact accepted checkpoint tree.

placement_certificate.trigger: A supervisor has bound an immutable candidate/profile and an exact selection disposition for each configured specialist perspective.
placement_certificate.producer: A stateless native-review closure adapter under Slice Campaign coordinates the canonical reviewer runtime, Review Episode, Implementation Review, and Claim Evidence services with stable transition and operation identities.
placement_certificate.state_owner: Slice Campaign stores selection and exact closure references only; Review Episode stores retained result/remediation state; Claim Evidence stores finding revisions and reliance; Implementation Review and reviewer-runtime keep their existing meanings.
placement_certificate.consumer: The builder receives episode result plus a thin relevant-exact-claim-revision projection and owns finding evaluation/remediation; the supervisor receives reconstructable obligation closure and owns synthesis, acceptance, and terminalization.
placement_certificate.lifecycle: Owner operations publish first under stable idempotent identities; campaign CAS binds their exact revisions last. Restart reconciliation replays or reads exact owner identities and refuses drift, missing authority, stale campaign revision, incomplete specialist disposition, or unresolved blocking state.
placement_certificate.semantic_consequence: A finding is revision-bound to the immutable review subject, can be relied on only by an attributed builder decision, can advance through retained remediation without losing lineage, and cannot itself accept the review or campaign.
placement_certificate.downstream_proof: A SQLite-backed end-to-end fixture executes selection, initial finding publication, thin projection delivery, builder reliance, remediation candidate, retained re-evaluation, restart recovery, terminal receipt, and legacy outcome comparison.
placement_certificate.insufficient_substitute: One raw Implementation Review binding, a claim record treated as verdict, reviewer self-selection, unbound prose findings, generic authorized-vertical success, or an active second claim/review/context store.
